context: The skill should write selector code that separates boolean-only validation from value-reading Optional branches.

checklist.name: Creates requested selector
checklist.description: Creates DiagnosticSelector.java with select(Optional<String>, Optional<Path>, List<String>) and the requested Selection record.

checklist.name: Preserves conflict behavior
checklist.description: Throws IllegalArgumentException with the exact --board/--workflow message when both selectors are present.

checklist.name: Uses Optional selector boundaries
checklist.description: Uses map/orElseGet or another direct Optional/value-binding shape for board and workflow branches after the conflict check.

checklist.name: No value-read antipattern
checklist.description: Does not use isPresent()/isEmpty() followed by get() or orElseThrow() for the selector value branches.

checklist.name: No null or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, stream().toList(), lists, or loops to unwrap either Optional selector.
